annotation.title_clean: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products: Implementing the AI White Paper principles
annotation.title_en: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products: Implementing the AI White Paper principles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)
named_instruments_referenced: UK AI White Paper (Pro-innovation approach to AI regulation)
annotation.summary_en: MHRA's April 2024 report responding to the UK Secretary of State, describing how it applies the five pro-innovation AI principles as a regulator of AI as a medical device (software), as a service provider using AI, and as an evidence-based decision-maker. It covers regulatory reform, guidance, the AI Airlock sandbox and resources.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI used for a medical purpose falls under the UK Medical Devices Regulations 2002.
MHRA is reforming medical device regulation to be proportionate for AI as a medical device.
AI Airlock regulatory sandbox for AI medical devices is being developed.
Guidance on good machine learning practice and predetermined change control plans is in place or planned.
MHRA co-chairs the IMDRF AI/ML working group and partners with US FDA and Health Canada.
